lines.text: I need oil that keeps magical light steady. Is this bottle really suitable for a rune lantern?
Can you read that old writing? They told me it was only decoration.
I nearly bought it. Thank you. The instructions are more useful than the wrapping.
This one says, "Keeps the wick steady. Keep away from open flames." This time the price is not offered as proof.
You are not a regular here, are you? Yet you read the instructions more carefully than the seller.
You can call me Lyse. As for the rest... today I am only here to buy lamp oil.
Salt and vegetables are still on your list. The stall ahead has fresh produce. I can show you.
Travelers will appreciate hot soup. More than a long menu, I would like to know if there is a seat.
Beyond the stone bridge, beside the main road. I will remember. If I have time this afternoon, I will visit.
No. It sometimes reacts to unstable magic. Has anything changed to the north recently?
Then listen to her. Someone buying vegetables need not investigate a mine alone.
Good. Thank you for your help today, Lu Chuan. Keep the direction of that light in mind.
